title: Approaching I/O-optimality for Approximate Attention
abstract: arXiv:2605.23751v2 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: We revisit the I/O complexity of attention in large language models. Given query-key-value matrices $Q,K,V\in\mathbb{R}^{n\times d}$, and a machine with fast memory size $M$, the goal is to compute the "attention matrix" $A=\text{softmax}(Q K ^{\top}/\sqrt{d}) V$ with the minimal number of data transfers between fast and slow memory. Existing methods in the literature, most notably FlashAttention and its variants, incur an I/O cost that depends quadratically on the context length $n$, while a trivial lower bound only requires $\Omega(nd)$ I/O's to read the inputs and write the output. In this work we show that the dependence on $n$ can be reduced to almost-linear, by developing I/O-efficient algorithms inspired by the recent approximate attention method of Alman and Song [NeurIPS'23]. translated_title: 逼近近似注意力的 I/O 最优性
translated_abstract: 我们重新审视了大语言模型中注意力机制的 I/O 复杂度。给定查询-键-值矩阵 Q, K, V ∈ R^{n×d}，以及一台快速内存大小为 M 的机器，目标是以快慢内存之间最少的数据传输次数计算“注意力矩阵” A = softmax(QK^⊤/√d)V。文献中现有的方法，尤其是 FlashAttention 及其变体，其 I/O 开销关于上下文长度 n 呈二次依赖，而一个平凡的下界仅需 Ω(nd) 次 I/O 来读取输入并写出输出。在这项工作中，我们受 Alman 和 Song [NeurIPS'23] 最新的近似注意力方法启发，开发了 I/O 高效的算法，证明了对 n 的依赖可以降低到几乎线性。我们还提供了在不同参数区域下的（算法特定的）下界，它们几乎匹配相应的上界，表明该算法接近最优。
tldr: 本文提出了受近似注意力方法启发的 I/O 高效算法，将注意力计算的 I/O 复杂度对上下文长度 n 的依赖从二次降低到几乎线性，并给出了几乎匹配的算法特定下界，证明了其接近最优性。
en_tdlr: This paper develops I/O-efficient approximate attention algorithms inspired by Alman and Song's method, reducing the I/O complexity's dependence on context length n from quadratic to almost-linear, with nearly matching algorithm-specific lower bounds demonstrating near-optimality.
